name: Murgado Lincoln of Chicago
climate: Chicago: harsh winters with sub-zero wind chills and heavy snow, road salt from November through March that speeds underbody corrosion, freeze-thaw potholes in March and April, cold starts that strain batteries and thicken oil, and hot, humid summers with stop-and-go traffic on the Kennedy Expressway and city streets.
brandNaming: Write Lincoln model names as Lincoln styles them (Corsair, Corsair Grand Touring, Nautilus, Aviator, Navigator, Navigator L); the Nautilus hybrid is an available Nautilus powertrain, not a separate model line

Say 'Lincoln Certified' (service, technicians or pre-owned) only when quoting a cited Lincoln or dealer source; do not describe staff as certified, factory-trained or master technicians; attribute service capability to the dealer's /lincoln-service page
No Ford branding, Ford model names or Ford copy; name Ford Motor Company only when a cited source (such as Lincoln warranty documents) requires it
Murgado Ford of Chicago shares the 2501 N Elston Ave address; do not mention it unless the article is about it, and never link murgadofordchicago.com from a Lincoln article

Use the dealer's program names as written on its site (Lincoln Pickup & Delivery at /pickup-and-delivery, Mobile Service at /mobile-auto-service, Lincoln Access Rewards at /lincoln-access-rewards) and quote terms from those pages or lincoln.com, not from memory
Do not repeat About Us superlatives (such as 'the newest and largest Lincoln dealership in Chicagoland') as fact
